title: No Cross Matching
constraintsSummary:
Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq N \leq 300; 0 \leq A_i, B_i, C_i, D_i \leq 5000 (1 \leq i \leq N); (A_i, B_i) 
eq (A_j, B_j) (1 \leq i < j \leq N); (C_i, D_i) 
eq (C_j, D_j) (1 \leq i < j \leq N); (A_i, B_i) 
eq (C_j, D_j) (1 \leq i, j \leq N); No three different points lie on the same straight line.; All input values are integers.
